name: Mrs. M. M. Coleman
role: Wife of M. M. Coleman of Medora
bio: Mrs. M. M. Coleman and her husband celebrated their 18th wedding anniversary in February 1885. That June she was struck by a spasm that left her unconscious for several days, but she recovered.

moments.label: Recovered after days unconscious from a spasm

mentions: M. M. and Mrs. Coleman celebrated their eighteenth wedding anniversary, the evening of the twenty-second. There was a large attendance of friends and many were the expressions of good will to…
Mrs. M. M. Coleman was prostrated last Saturday by a kind of spasm that left her entirely unconscious for several days. She is now considered out of danger.
A baby girl was born to Mr. and Mrs. Coleman last Monday.
A dance will be given the evening of February 22, by Mr. and Mrs. Coleman. All are cordially invited.
